task_description: Phase 2 Sub-Phase 1: Implement a working HTTP web server for the vek language. This includes a native module/stdlib system, an epoll-based event loop, HTTP/1.1 parser and server with trie-based routing, and core stdlib packages (log, env, json, time, crypto, path, uuid, kv, cache). The end result is a vek program that can define route handlers and serve HTTP requests.

verification.summary: All tests pass: 106 unit tests (compiler 20, event_loop 7, gc 6, lexer 31, object 18, value 24) + 9 integration tests + 7 HTTP server tests + 20 web app tests. Build compiles cleanly with 0 errors. Three review iterations completed, addressing 12 total issues (7 v1, 3 v2, 2 v3) including security hardening (body size limits, connection limits, timeouts, error responses) and memory safety (EpollData ownership, use-after-free fixes, state cleanup on close).
